notes.title: Release date – April 15!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274021/63c1a8f183857675df076a0b962d8ca5cabdbce5.jpg

Okay, the tests are finally done, and I can announce the game's release date – April 15, in the evening. It's always nerve-wracking, but yes, it seems like it's done!  

Lately, I've been working on the boss fight in the final level, secrets, and making sure they actually work. I've also been tidying up the level design, working on the intro and the final credits—just a bunch of different things, as usual.  

Let's see how it all turned out. I hope you'll like it!
